author: dcabfx
text:
Redbullish, your marking is very good and I like that you're watching for the return and the engulf. Very nice, keep it up. A suggestion if I may is to look out for flags, mark the limit, watch them respected, then broken and watch for what price does when returning to that area again. Track and mark that too (the breaks) and you'll see something that really lights you up. Do this starting from as far back as you can go and with any instrument.

FL's are amazing and the opportunities

when price returns and the engulfs of them will pave the road for great things.

Enjoy! dcabfx

That's a great question and I'm noticing it's your first post. Welcome!! The base of the pole is important as well. It's what makes up the Bull or Bear flag as a whole so it needs attention also.

I'm not sure where you are in terms of technical analysis or even the markets but I would encourage you to go through Markeopedia and get up to speed on things over there and start with some Supply and Demand pockets (CAPS).
